annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (Oman)
key_provisions_or_claims: Pillar 1: adopt AI in economic sectors, factories, government buildings and citizen-facing services
Incentives for local cloud firms to offer AI as a service
Pillar 2: localize AI through capacity building, infrastructure and R&D
Pillar 3: human-centered governance, with review and update of laws and policies
Focus on ethical, fair, safe AI, data governance and community privacy
annotation.summary_en: Oman Ministry web page describing the National Program for AI and Advanced Digital Technologies, with three pillars: adopting AI in economic sectors, localizing AI technologies, and human-centered governance of AI applications. Mainly promotes adoption and capacity building; ethics and law review are mentioned briefly.
